## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-*juan* combined-edition (*huìběn* 會本) interweaving Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn yìshū* ([KR6d0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0048), T1728) with Zhīlǐ's *Guānyīn yìshū jì* ([KR6d0049](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0049), T1729) into a single readable text. The companion to the *Xuányì jì huìběn* of [KR6d0052](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0052); together the two combined-editions complete [王季常](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%A3%E5%B8%B8) Wáng Jìcháng's late-Míng editorial project on the Tiāntái *Pǔmén* corpus, undertaken at Jīnlíng in Chóngzhēn 崇禎 1–2 (1628–1629).

**Abstract**

The combined-edition (*huìběn*) is a late-Míng editorial product designed to make Zhīlǐ's Sòng-period subcommentary on Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn yìshū* accessible to a non-scholarly readership. Together with the parallel *Xuányì jì huìběn* ([KR6d0052](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0052)) and the four auxiliary navigational works ([KR6d0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0050), [KR6d0051](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0051), [KR6d0053](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0053), [KR6d0054](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0054)), it constitutes [王季常](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%A3%E5%B8%B8) Wáng Jìcháng's complete late-Míng editorial reorganisation of the Tiāntái *Pǔmén* corpus into a unified accessible format.

The substantive content remains the Sui-period *Yìshū* of Zhìyǐ and the Sòng-period *Yìshū jì* of Zhīlǐ; for the doctrinal discussion of these works see [KR6d0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0048) and [KR6d0049](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0049) respectively. The *huìběn* itself is a late-Míng editorial production (1628–1629) and contributes no new doctrinal content beyond the editorial reorganisation.
